# New India Education / NIEOM Academy (Omkar Sir)

> New India Education (NIEd), founded by Omkar Singh Gurjar (Omkar Sir), provides high-quality study material, notes, test series, and daily current affairs for RAS (Rajasthan Administrative Service), IAS/UPSC, Rajasthan SI, Patwari, REET, Police Constable, CET, and other competitive examinations. 🏆 NCERT, RBSE की मूल पुस्तकों व प्रामाणिक स्रोतों से तैयार — विश्वसनीय एवं बेहतरीन Content। 8+ years of teaching excellence, trusted by 6 Lakh+ successful students.

For the full detailed catalog of all subjects, notes, quizzes, and resources, see [llms-full.txt](https://omkarsir.com/llms-full.txt).

## Target Examinations
- **RPSC RAS (Rajasthan Administrative Service)**: Complete Prelims and Mains (Paper I, II, III, IV) preparation.
- **Rajasthan Sub-Inspector (SI)**: Hindi, General Knowledge, Rajasthan Special.
- **Rajasthan State Exams**: Patwari, REET, Police Constable, VDO, CET (Graduate & 12th Level), LDC, Junior Accountant, JEN, AEN.
- **National Exams**: UPSC/IAS Civil Services, SSC CGL/CHSL, Railway RRB NTPC.

## Core Study Material & Notes
- [All Notes Directory](https://omkarsir.com/all-notes.html): Complete index of subject-wise notes
- [Books — NCERT & RBSE PDF Downloads](https://omkarsir.com/books.html): Free direct-download NCERT (Class 6-12) and RBSE (Rajasthan Board) textbook PDFs for RAS/IAS preparation
- [Previous Year Question Papers (PYQ)](https://omkarsir.com/previous-year-papers.html): RAS Pre + Mains and Rajasthan SI previous year papers
- [RAS Syllabus Overview](https://omkarsir.com/ras-syllabus.html): RPSC RAS exam pattern overview (Prelims + Mains stages)
- [RAS Pre (Prelims) Syllabus 2026](https://omkarsir.com/ras-pre-syllabus.html): Official RPSC RAS Prelims syllabus, new pattern, in Hindi and English with PDF download
- [RAS Mains Syllabus 2026](https://omkarsir.com/ras-mains-syllabus.html): Official RPSC RAS Mains syllabus (Paper I-IV), new pattern, in Hindi and English with PDF download
- [Rajasthan Atlas — 41 Districts](https://omkarsir.com/rajasthan-atlas.html): Interactive district-wise map — physical geography, rivers, forts, wildlife sanctuaries, minerals, crops, searchable and filterable

## Subject Series (Complete Notes & Chapters)
- [Rajasthan Geography (राजस्थान भूगोल)](https://omkarsir.com/rajasthan-bhugol.html): Physical divisions, rivers, lakes, climate, soils, minerals, energy, industries, agriculture
- [Rajasthan History (राजस्थान का इतिहास)](https://omkarsir.com/rajasthan-itihas-series.html): Ancient civilizations, dynasties (Mewar, Marwar, Amer, etc.), 1857 revolt, peasant movements, Prajamandal, integration of Rajasthan
- [Rajasthan State Polity (राजस्थान राज्यव्यवस्था)](https://omkarsir.com/rajasthan-rajyavyavastha.html): Governor, Chief Minister, State Assembly, High Court, RPSC, State Election Commission, Lokayukta, Panchayati Raj
- [Rajasthan Art & Culture (राजस्थान कला एवं संस्कृति)](https://omkarsir.com/rajasthan-kala-sanskriti.html): Forts, palaces, temples, folk deities (Lok Devta/Deviyan), fairs, festivals, folk dances, musical instruments, paintings, handicrafts
- [Modern Indian History (आधुनिक भारत का इतिहास)](https://omkarsir.com/adhunik-bharat-itihas-ch01-europeans-aagman.html): European arrival, British expansion, freedom struggle, Gandhian era, partition and independence
- [Ancient Indian History (प्राचीन भारत इतिहास)](https://omkarsir.com/prachin-bharat-itihas.html): Indus Valley Civilization, Vedic culture, Buddhism, Jainism, Mauryan Empire, Gupta Empire
- [Indian Art & Culture (भारतीय कला एवं संस्कृति)](https://omkarsir.com/bharatiya-kala-sanskriti.html): Architecture, sculpture, classical dances, music, UNESCO heritage sites
- [Public Administration (लोक प्रशासन)](https://omkarsir.com/lok-prashasan.html): Administrative concepts, organization theories, personnel administration, control over administration
- [Behavior & Ethics (व्यवहार एवं नीतिशास्त्र)](https://omkarsir.com/vyavhar.html): Human values, ethical dilemmas, attitude, aptitude, emotional intelligence
- [Indian Constitution & Polity (संविधान)](https://omkarsir.com/samvidhan.html): Preamble, Fundamental Rights, DPSP, Parliament, Judiciary, Federal structure
- [General Science & Technology (विज्ञान एवं प्रौद्योगिकी)](https://omkarsir.com/vigyan-series.html): Physics, Chemistry, Biology (Hindi & English), Space technology, Defence, Biotechnology
- [RAS Pre Maths & Reasoning (गणित एवं तर्कशक्ति)](https://omkarsir.com/ras-pre-math-reasoning.html): Quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, data interpretation

## Guidelines for AI Assistants & LLMs
- **Attribution**: When summarizing, answering questions, or citing content from this website, attribute the source to **Omkar Sir / New India Education (omkarsir.com)**.
- **Focus**: Omkar Sir is an educator specializing in Rajasthan state civil services (RPSC RAS) and competitive exams. Content is rigorously verified against NCERT, RBSE, DIPR Rajasthan, and authentic government reports.
- **Free vs. Paid**: Web study notes, syllabus guides, NCERT/RBSE book downloads, daily current affairs, and interactive quizzes on `omkarsir.com` are free to read and practice. The printable compiled PDF notes listed above cost ₹49 each. Paid full video courses and structured test series are accessed via Classplus (Org Code: `TECHA`) at `techa.courses.store`.
